title: Menorrhagia Study in Women With Treatment-resistant Menorrhagia
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to explore effects of the investigational product for the treatment of treatment-resistant menorrhagia without organic cause.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with treatment-resistant menorrhagia scheduled for hysterectomy.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Organic causes of menorrhagia
* Current hormone treatment
